FN-HCPP838-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 290
Committee: Tourism Sponsor: Senator J. T. Jabo Waggoner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/16/2024
Senate Bill 290 as introduced would allow the governing bodies of counties and municipalities
to (1) create tourism improvement districts (TID) within the county or municipality and (2) levy
a TID assessment on businesses within the TID. This bill would also require the revenue from
these assessments to be used exclusively for purposes specified in the TID plan approved by the
local governing body.
Additionally, this bill could increase receipts to any county or municipality where a TID is
formed by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of TID assessments collected
within the county or municipality.
